{{Vanilla|Stonecutter}}
{{Infobox auto}}
The '''stonecutter''' is a block that turns one block or item into another in a single step. In Matcha Flavoured it works with far more than stone: the pack adds 348 stonecutter recipes for wood, metal, glass, mud and dirt, and keeps the 319 vanilla recipes, so most building materials can be cut without waste.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is the vanilla one: an [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]] above three [[limestone]].

== Usage ==
The stonecutter works exactly as in vanilla ''Minecraft''. What changes is the list of inputs it accepts. The design video sums it up: "Stone cutters give you more bang for your buck. Can be used with almost all materials."<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Stone cutters give you more bang for your buck. Can be used with almost all materials.}}</ref>

The pack's recipes follow a few patterns:
* '''Logs''' of every wood type (including stripped logs, wood, stems and hyphae) can be cut straight into that wood's planks (4), slabs (8), stairs (4), fences (3), fence gates, doors (2), trapdoors (4), buttons (8), pressure plates (4), signs (2) and shelves. Any log also gives a [[barrel]], a chiseled bookshelf or 16 [[ladder]]s.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/ladder_from_stonecutting_any_logs.json}}</ref> Logs, wood and their stripped forms can be converted into each other.
* '''Planks''' give 2 slabs, stairs, a trapdoor or 2 buttons. '''Stairs''' can be cut back into planks and '''trapdoors''' into slabs, so a wrong cut can be undone.
* '''Metals''': an [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]] or [[Copper Ingot|copper ingot]] gives 4 bars, 6 chains or a trapdoor. A block of iron or copper gives 36 bars, 54 chains, 6 doors or 9 trapdoors, and a block of copper also gives 4 [[Lightning Rod|lightning rod]]s. [[Steel Alloy]] gives twice as much as an iron ingot (8 bars, 12 chains, 2 trapdoors, a door or a [[cauldron]]). Every oxidized and waxed form of copper has its own set.
* '''Glass''': [[glass]] and every stained glass can be cut into 4 panes.
* '''Other''': [[dirt]] into 2 [[Dirt Slab|dirt slabs]], [[Packed Mud|packed mud]] into mud bricks and their slab, stairs and wall, [[hellbricks]] into 3 [[Hellbrick Fence|hellbrick fences]], and [[limestone]] into 4 [[Stone Button|stone button]]s or 4 [[Stone Pressure Plate|stone pressure plate]]s.

Chiseled blocks, which vanilla crafts from two slabs, must be made in the stonecutter instead, because the pack uses two slabs in a crafting grid to turn them back into their full block.<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.6-alpha|quote=Chiseled Blocks can no longer be crafted with slabs and must be done using the stonecutter}}</ref>

== Recipes ==
=== Added by Matcha Flavoured ===
Every stonecutter recipe the pack adds. Each wood type has nearly the same set, so only oak is expanded.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History
|{{History line|0.6-alpha|Chiseled blocks can no longer be crafted from slabs and must be made in the stonecutter.}}
{{History line|1.10|Iron chains can be cut from iron ingots.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Glass can be cut into panes.<br />Chiseled bookshelves can be made in the stonecutter.<br />Poplar was added to the stonecutter, according to the release notes.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* The 1.12.1-alpha release notes say poplar was added to the stonecutter, but poplar does not exist in the ''Minecraft'' version the pack targets and the current source has no poplar recipes. See [[Poplar]].
* Birch is the only wood whose planks can be cut into a pressure plate; for the other woods, pressure plates only come from logs.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/birch_pressure_plate_from_stonecutting_birch_planks.json}}</ref>
* Exposed copper and waxed exposed copper each have two identical recipes for their trapdoors.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/exposed_copper_trapdoor_from_stonecutting_exposed_copper_block.json}}</ref>
